references.text: Here is told the original account of the death of Nadab and Abihu when they offered strange fire before the Lord.
Refers back to the death of Aaron's sons and gives instructions on how Aaron should approach the Lord to avoid the same fate.
Repeats the information that Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the Lord.
Confirms that Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and that Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
Mentions Aaron's four sons: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar are chosen for priestly service.
Mentions the names of Aaron's sons who were anointed for priestly service.
Moses speaks to Eleazar and Ithamar, Aaron's surviving sons, after the death of Nadab and Abihu.
